description: This source file contains the final class PrometheusBasedResourceLimitChecks, which implements resource limit checks by querying a Prometheus server for metrics such as connection counts and data payload volumes, and performs calculations based on tenant configurations. It includes methods for executing Prometheus queries, extracting values, and computing allowed data volumes over specified periods.

classes.name: PrometheusBasedResourceLimitChecks
classes.description: Implements resource limit validation by querying Prometheus server metrics for tenant-specific resource thresholds, including connection counts and data volume usage, with support for caching and period-based calculations.

classes.name: PeriodMode
classes.description: Enumeration representing the mode of data volume calculation: DAYS, MONTHLY, or UNKNOWN.

methods.name: isConnectionLimitReached
methods.description: Checks if a tenant's current authenticated connection count exceeds its configured maximum connections by querying Prometheus metrics.

methods.name: isMessageLimitReached
methods.description: Determines whether the tenant has exceeded its configured data volume limit based on the configured period (days or monthly), by aggregating metrics from Prometheus.

methods.name: executeQuery
methods.description: Performs an HTTP GET request to the Prometheus server with the given query and returns the numerical result as a Future.

methods.name: extractLongValue
methods.description: Parses the JSON response from Prometheus to extract and return a long value representing the metric's value.

methods.name: calculateDataVolume
methods.description: Calculates the allowed data volume in bytes for the current period, adjusting for partial months if necessary.

methods.name: calculateDataUsagePeriod
methods.description: Calculates the number of days or months over which data usage is measured based on tenant settings.
